_what: Launch from zero: a brand with no site, customers or past ads yet. Every step names the tool in this repo that does it. A step this repo has no tool for says status "gap": it is not done and not improvised. It waits until a tool is built and added here.
_rule: The owner gives a hunch: one line naming a product or ingredient and the market. Nothing else of the owner's goes in. The research decides the rest from receipts, and it may prove the hunch wrong.

steps.name: Private offer workspace (the brand's own repo; Prizm stays private)
steps.fills: a private repo: brands/<brand>/, offers/, runs/

phases.name: 1 · Research
phases._source: the order is components/research-fill/process.json; run and check each with components/research-fill/fill.py

steps.name: Name the avatar and build his profile
steps.tool: skill avatar-profile (outside research: Reddit, YouTube, TikTok)

steps.name: Connect the brand's own words
steps.note: a brand from zero has no reviews, comments or inbox yet; connect each once it exists

steps.name: What the market is buying; one competitor deep
The unique mechanism, from the studies only
steps.tool: reads products/<product>/evidence/EVIDENCE.md; each line cites its study

steps.name: Owner picks concepts on the matrix
Brand name, with domain and trademark check
Design system: tokens, components, style guide
steps.tool: skills-library brand-from-zero stage 6; design-system skill (catalog); Design System artifact

steps.name: The offer sheet, inside the owner's margin envelope
Find and compare suppliers
steps.tool: Apify (scraping, per the tool map) for supplier listings; vendor-evaluation skill (catalog) to compare

steps.name: Label and packaging mockups
steps.tool: skills-library brand-from-zero stage 7 (Higgsfield product renders, canvas-design)

steps.name: Store on Next Commerce (29 Next), one shot
steps.tool: skills next-theme-design, next-theme-dev, next-campaigns-setup (installed on this Mac, not in the Prizm repo)
steps.owner_click: the store account and its keys

steps.name: Statics: teardown → writing → production → edit
steps.tool: skills image-teardown, image-writing, image-production, image-edit; a whole round with statics-sprint

steps.name: Pages: teardown → writing → production
steps.tool: skill teardown-page; components page-teardown, page-writing, page-production, product-page

steps.name: Drop kit for the ad account

_sources: Prizm skills and components; Prizm skills-library (recipes/brand-from-zero.md, recipes/tool-map.md, catalog.json via tools/find.py); Next Commerce skills installed on this Mac.
_runs_on: Everything runs from Prizm Labs: Prizm's own keys (its .env, read through components/keys/loader.py) and Prizm's own private runs/ (components/run-lanes). Never the team workspace's keys, runs or tools.
